blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bicol Saro Rep. Terry Ridon on Tuesday urged President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to consider expelling lower-ranking Chinese diplomats if he does not want to expel China’s envoy to the country. At a media briefing, Ridon said lower-ranking diplomatic officers, particularly those managing the Chinese Embassy in Manila’s Facebook page, should be removed amid continuing criticism of Philippine officials online. “Our appeal is not to expel the Chinese ambassador. Our appeal at this point … is to expel the lesser diplomats, particularly those operating the Chinese embassy’s Facebook account,” Ridon, a member of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, said […]...
